verdict.rationale: Letta's memory architecture is explicitly agent-invoked: /remember lets the agent decide where to commit lessons to MemFS, /doctor audits placement/duplication, /search finds messages across agents, and dreaming subagents autonomously consolidate and update memory mid-session without interrupting work — all framed as self-directed memory operations the agent performs via its own tool calls. Community commentary corroborates the design intent (memory-first, transparent white-box memory influencing prompts). missing for 10: no first-party benchmark or hands-on third-party test explicitly showing the agent invoking add/search/update/delete memory tools in a live conversation, and no independent verification of dreaming/doctor behavior in practice.
